newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down as major issues decline.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down as major issues decline.

text.p: More profit taking on Czech major issues pulled the PX50 index down 0.2 percent to 627.6 on Wednesday while the high cap dominated RPIX index lost 0.5 percent to 1,354.2.
CEZ was the biggest loser, dropping 17 crowns, 1.4 percent to 1,227. SPT Telecom fell 55 crowns, 1.39 percent, to 3,985 and Komercni Banka lost 20 crowns to 2,950.
"It is a kind of logical correction after the market moved up so heavily (recently), especially in Komercni and Telecom," said Milan Krch from Citicorp Securities.
Despite the poor performance of the highly capitalised sahres there were some strong gains in the broader market.
Petrochemical stocks Chemopetrol and Kaucuk continued to move higher after Monday's announcement detailing their share swap ratios in the forthcoming Unipetrol mega-merger.

Tobacco company Tabak and electricity generator Elektrarny Opatovice again posted year highs. Tabak, which is 77 percent owned by Philip Morris, gained five crowns to 8,555 and Opatovice rose 107 crowns to 5,000.
Overall volume was moderate at 1,253,363 shares on turnover of 1.3 billion crowns.
